name: Ami ~Shoushin no Tenshi~
source:
Ami loves her brother-in-law and one day had relationship with him. But the event was caught by her parents, who then decided to separate Ami from her brother-in-law for their own good.

Ami's heart is filled with sadness, so her two female friends suggest going to a summer resort to heal the damage. A sentimental adventure from the viewpoint of three different girls begins now.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阿米爱她的姐夫，有一天和他发生了关系。但这件事被她的父母发现了，他们为了自己的利益决定将阿米和她的姐夫分开。

阿美心中充满悲伤，两位女性朋友建议去避暑胜地疗伤。从三个不同女孩的角度出发的感伤冒险现在开始。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
